description:
[Trading Data API] Free API key, step 2: send the wallet, the message from step 1 and its EIP-191 signature to receive a key (shown once). One key per wallet; signing again rotates it. Each key gets a daily credit budget and a per-minute limit on paid endpoints; when credits run out the endpoint returns the normal x402 payment challenge.

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

message.description: The message returned by GET /v1/keys/message, unchanged.

signature.description: 0x EIP-191 personal_sign signature of the message.

name: keys
